Frequent prompt-relative hypotheses: light: soft diffuse lighting (25/32 frames); material: smooth digital surfaces (32/32 frames); medium: a 3D render (23/32 frames); setting: an abstract composition (31/32 frames); tone: a tense ominous image (18/32 frames). Frequent optional PixelCue tag hypotheses: AS BOTTLE CO 17 (2).
synthesis.audio_control: 16 matched programme-versus-silence comparisons had median hue divergence 0.000 bits. Differences may also reflect unseeded projectM rendering or feedback evolution, not just musical response.

synthesis.interpretation_limits: PixelCue features quantify sampled rasters, not subjective quality or creative intention. BLIP captions, CLIP prompts and VLM tags are fallible per-frame hypotheses. Still frames cannot establish flash safety or perceived motion quality. Only an authenticated artist-provided suite can establish behaviour on actual album audio.
synthesis.observed_effects: Across input families, colour-bars: hue divergence median 0.111 bits, texture divergence median 0.557 bits across 8 observed pairs; cover-lyrics: hue divergence median 0.047 bits, texture divergence median 0.297 bits across 8 observed pairs; grid-rings: hue divergence median 0.019 bits, texture divergence median 0.292 bits across 8 observed pairs; text-card: hue divergence median unavailable bits, texture divergence median 0.205 bits across 8 observed pairs.
synthesis.scope: Observed 32 paired source/output measurements across 8 declared conditions, including 2 cover/lyric conditions and output times 0, 0.5, 1.5, 3 seconds.
synthesis.temporal_behaviour: For successive captures of the same input condition, median measured texture divergence was 0.006 bits across 24 transitions.
